entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Can I talk to you for a sec?
What is it?
I'm busy.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It'll be quick.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It'll be quick.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Anyway, what's with you? Like, how you[n]were late the other day was a lie and all.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...There's that weird rumor about you too.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Whaddya want with him?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Right back at you. You're not even in[n]our class.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...We just happened to get to know[n]each other.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What're you planning on doing to[n]Mr. Kamoshida?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...I see. I getcha.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You're all buddy-buddy with[n]Kamoshida after all.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: This has nothing to do with you,[n]Sakamoto!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: If you found out what he's been doin'[n]behind your back, you'd dump him[n]right away.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Behind my back...?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What's that supposed to mean?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You wouldn't get it.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Anyway, people are already talking about[n]you two.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I don't know what you're trying to pull,[n]but no one's gonna help you.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm warning you, just in case. That's all.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Why's she gotta be so aggressive all[n]the time?
You know her?
She seemed annoyed.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We just went to the same middle school.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: She's been like that since middle school.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Anyways, that's not what we're here to[n]talk about.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I had no luck on my end.[n]What about you?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Did anything like someone's name[n]turn up?
Mishima.
Kitajima.
Emphysema.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh...?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Was there anyone by that name on the[n]volleyball team...?
It might have been a different name...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh? I don't get where you're goin' with[n]that...
It might have been a different name...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Special "coaching," huh?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: True. I always see the guy covered in[n]bruises.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Let's go talk to him before he leaves then.
